Route Module: default component.description:
The route's default export renders when the path matches.
It receives `loaderData`, `actionData`, `params` and `matches` as props — no `useLoaderData()` needed in Framework mode.
Types come from the generated `./+types/<route>` module.

Route Module: meta.description:
Returns the `<meta>` and `<title>` tags for this route, rendered by the `<Meta />` component in root.
In React Router v8 the `data` argument is replaced by `loaderData`.

Route Module: links.description:
Returns `<link>` descriptors, rendered by the `<Links />` component in root.
Use it for stylesheets, preloads and icons scoped to this route.

Route Module: headers.description:
HTTP headers for the document response of this route. Server-only.
Only the leaf-most route's `headers` is used unless parents are merged explicitly.

Route Module: ErrorBoundary.description:
Renders in place of the route when its loader, action or component throws.
Requires `import { isRouteErrorResponse } from 'react-router'` to tell thrown Responses from real errors.

Route Module: HydrateFallback.description:
Shown during the initial hydration while a `clientLoader` with `hydrate = true` runs.
Only applies to the first render — later navigations use `useNavigation()` instead.

Route Module: shouldRevalidate.description:
Opt this route's loader out of revalidation after actions or navigations.
Return `false` to keep the existing `loaderData`. Use sparingly — stale data is the usual bug.

Route Module: middleware.description:
Runs on the server before and after the loaders/actions below it. Use for auth, logging and response post-processing.
Calling `next()` continues down the chain. Requires the `v8_middleware` future flag.

Route Module: clientMiddleware.description:
Browser-side middleware, running around client loaders and actions.
Requires the `v8_middleware` future flag.

Route Module: handle.description:
Arbitrary per-route data, readable from any component via `useMatches()`.
The usual use is breadcrumbs — see the `rr-breadcrumbs` snippet.

Route Module: Layout (root).description:
Wraps every route, including error states. Defined in `root.tsx`.
It must render the document shell — `<Meta />`, `<Links />`, `<ScrollRestoration />` and `<Scripts />`.
